source_blocks.quote: With the launch of the new Online Collection, the Rijksmuseum brings art and history closer than ever.
source_blocks.context: With the launch of the new Online Collection, the Rijksmuseum brings art and history closer than ever. This innovative platform opens a world of beauty and knowledge, where images, archival sources, stories, and research come together.

source_blocks.heading: About Collection Online
source_blocks.quote: The introduction of the new Online Collection marks another step in the Rijksmuseum's important mission: making art and heritage accessible to everyone.

Through an innovative search bar and hundreds of automatically generated theme pages, you step into a treasure trove of art, history, and knowledge. The possibilities are endless.

source_blocks.heading: About Collection Online
source_blocks.quote: Linked Open Data The Online Collection uses Linked Open Data, making art and knowledge available in a structured and accessible way.
source_blocks.context: Linked Open Data The Online Collection uses Linked Open Data, making art and knowledge available in a structured and accessible way. The platform continues to grow with new images, data, and an expanding range of collection sources. The Rijksmuseum offers renewed open data services, enabling the collection to be easily used in personal applications via open APIs. All freely available works can be downloaded in high resolution for both personal and commercial use.
